datasets_from_scratch_no_english_source.evidence: WikiBio is crawled from native-language Wikipedias. Headline Generation uses native-language Indian news articles (Hindi from Indian news websites, others from IndicGLUE). Sentence Summarization is derived from HG. Paraphrase Generation is mined from Samanantar parallel corpus using pivoting. None of these are translated from English source data.

datasets_translated_from_english.evidence: We start with the SQuAD training and development (Rajpurkar et al., 2016) question answering sets and repurpose them to serve as a question generation dataset... We then translate the data into Indic languages using the IndicTrans (Ramesh et al., 2022) English to Indic model.

details.Headline Generation: Native-language Indian news articles from sources like Dainik Bhaskar, Naidunia, NDTV, Business Standard, IndiaTV (Hindi) and IndicGLUE news data (other languages), covering culturally relevant topics.
details.Sentence Summarization: Derived from Headline Generation dataset, retains the same culturally grounded Indian news content.

all_annotators_native_speakers.value: Yes, for quality evaluation; dataset creation is automated
all_annotators_native_speakers.evidence: For each language, we hire two native-language annotators and pay them higher wages than the minimum hourly wages. Evaluation conducted on 4 representative languages (hi, bn, ml, kn) for WikiBio, Headline Generation, and Paraphrase Generation tasks. The underlying data for non-QG tasks is authored by native speakers (Wikipedia editors, news journalists, parallel corpus authors).

annotator_workforce.compensation_details: For quality evaluation annotators: 'we hire two native-language annotators and pay them higher wages than the minimum hourly wages'
annotator_workforce.evidence: Dataset creation is primarily automated (web scraping, parallel corpus mining, machine translation). Human annotators from AI4Bharat team were used only for quality evaluation of 3 tasks. Acknowledgements mention: 'We would like to thank Anupama Sujatha from AI4Bharat for helping in coordinating the annotation task, and extend thanks to all the annotators of AI4Bharat team.'

cultural_flags.english_centricity_notes: Question Generation task is directly translated from English SQuAD, inheriting English-centric content from English Wikipedia. Paraphrase Generation uses English as a pivot language for extraction, which constrains the data to sentences with English translations. The WikiBio task follows the English WikiBio paradigm. The paper acknowledges in Limitations: 'The question generation dataset is generated using machine translation, and it might consist of translationese.'

notably_excluded: Non-Indian Indic language regions (e.g., Bangladesh for Bengali, Nepal for Nepali, Pakistan for Urdu/Punjabi)
geographic_representation.evidence: The benchmark focuses on 11 Indian languages from two language families (Indo-Aryan and Dravidian). Languages belong to the 22 'scheduled' Indian languages listed in the Constitution of India. News data is from Indian news sources. The 11 languages are: Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu.
